messages.content: I’ll use down-regulation to build charge ahead of the evening peak, keep discharge within the daily cycle limit, and avoid up-reserve awards that would curtail solar. I’ll validate the day-ahead book before committing it.

The checks confirmed a 75 MW cap per reserve product and strict SoC backing requirements. I’m revising the book to avoid costly early cycling, then discharge into the 18:00–20:00 peak and hold the remaining charge for evening reserves.
The battery is full at 18:00. The evening discharge and reserve awards remain feasible, so I’ll keep the energy book unchanged for now and monitor any ERCOT notices or deployments.
